item.title: Iran targets Gulf countries' energy infrastructure after Israeli strike on gas field
item.summary: Iran launched a series of retaliatory strikes against the vital energy infrastructure in nearby Gulf states after Israel hit its largest gas field Wednesday.

item.title: WATCH: DNI Tulsi Gabbard provides intelligence assessment on Iran during Senate hearing
item.summary: Gabbard provided the latest intelligence community assessment on Iran on Wednesday, telling the Senate Intel Committee that Iran's regime "appears to be intact, but largely degraded due to attacks."

item.summary: 24/7 coverage of breaking news and live events

item.title: WATCH: Israel's Arrow air defense: Reporter's notebook
item.summary: ABC News' Tom Soufi Burridge was given rare access to an Israeli air force base to see the Arrow air defense system, Israel's longest-range air defense system.

item.title: 'I will follow the law,' Bondi says after Dems storm out of Epstein files briefing
item.summary: Democrats storm out in protest of a closed-door briefing on the Epstein files, characterizing it as a "fake hearing." Republicans chided them for a "premeditated" stunt.

item.title: Family seeks help finding 20-year-old University of Alabama student missing in Spain
item.summary: An Illinois family is asking the public for help and more information following the disappearance of their 20-year-old son, who was on a spring break trip in Spain.

item.title: WATCH: TSA agent on working without pay: No ‘fuel to continue coming to work'
item.summary: TSA Agent Jill Dejanovich says the agents who are still working amid the shortage will only stop when they are financially unable to do so, adding that they are already getting to that point.

item.title: WATCH: 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' trailer debuts
item.summary: The film's star, Tom Holland, enlisted the help of Spider-Man superfans from around the world.

item.title: WATCH: Massive meteor boom heard across several states
item.summary: A six-foot wide, seven-ton space rock traveled 34 miles through the upper atmosphere before disintegrating over Medina County in Ohio, according to NASA.

item.title: WATCH: 'Sinners' soundtrack's surge after the Oscars
item.summary: The performance of the Oscar-nominated music from the hit movie helped the soundtrack soar on streaming services.
